_what: An extension reading process.env or importing an authority-bearing node:* module. Counts may shrink, never grow.
_why_it_has_a_gate: An in-process extension reading process.env sees the ENGINE's whole environment - DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET, FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY - which is both far more than it needs and a way around the capability gate on ctx.internals: an extension wanting to decrypt without declaring 'secrets' could take the key and do it itself.
_it_is_empty_and_that_is_the_point: It held 24 sites for about an hour. They were invisible until 2026-08-18 because the gate walked a fixed <category>/<name>/engine path while 12 of 57 extensions live at another depth, so it reported 'with no exceptions' about the 45 it could see. Once visible they were converted: ai reads its providers from zv_ai_providers and its key through the host's 'ai' keyring, and search, billing and sms read ctx.config.vars - the host's slice of the environment, ZVELTIO_EXT_<NAME>_*, which contains that extension's keys and nothing else.
